description: Work with repository-native TypeScript release contracts in .tapp/contracts. Contracts express business guarantees through reusable Tasks, named actors, exact/eventual expectations, criticality, policy, and UI Map coverage. Compilation targets the same deterministic Flow/Scenario evidence contract; ordinary run is keyless and never invokes a model. Multi-actor isolated replay is currently web-only.

mapPath.description: Optional repo-relative UI Map v1 for coverage grounding

outPath.description: Compile: optional repo-relative deterministic JSON output

platform.description: Target platform; optional when the contract declares exactly one

updateMap.description: Explicitly add the reviewed contract coverage to mapPath

name: tapp_release_contract
title: Inspect, validate, compile, or run a release contract
